frames.title: 1. Mark. Check. Fold.

frames.title: 2. Close the triangle

frames.prompt: Fold the 4 × 1-in lip into two halves. Attach one half to F; leave a level ½-in shelf.
frames.check: Point to the changed part. Compare it with the plan, then swap maker and checker.

frames.title: 4. Change only the lip
frames.alt: Build a Stand for an Instruction Card: 4. Change only the lip
frames.prompt: Test three times. Replace the lip with a 1-in shelf and repeat with the same card and body.

Make.title: One move at a time.
Make.lead: Maker acts. Checker compares with the drawing. Swap roles at the pause.

frames.title: Run the trial

frames.prompt: Trial: put the stand on a level desk, place the card, remove both hands and time 10 seconds. Pass only if both stand and card stay upright. Remove the card; repeat for three trials.
